author: MLL-Lab
description:
Embodied First Exam: media
	

This repository holds the pictures, videos and agent runs behind the Embodied First Exam, a benchmark for code agents in robotics. Each question in the exam is a frozen simulation scene with a goal written for a person, and the answer is a program, which is marked by replaying it in a fresh simulator.
Leaderboard data (every counted attempt of the ranked agents, with a link to its full run): leaderboard/.

	
		
	
	
		Layout… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MLL-Lab/embodied-exam-data.
